description: IN-PT-CHN-001 (ZP-TAX-IN-2026-27-001 §21) — Greater Chennai Corporation's local half-yearly Professional Tax. Monthly gross ₹15,000 is assessed as an average HALF-YEAR income (assessment_basis="HALF_YEAR_INCOME") — india.py's _pt_assessment_income approximates this as 6× the period's gross = ₹90,000, which is > ₹75,001, so it matches the top tier (flat ₹1,250). pay_date is June, one of this fixture's configured half-year collection months, so the deduction actually fires (it resolves to ₹0 in any other month) — matching the doc's own stated 'average income >75,001: local PT 1,250' exactly.
source: ZP-TAX-IN-2026-27-001 §21 IN-PT-CHN-001 + §14.1 (Greater Chennai Corporation local PT schedule, source IN-CHN-PT). Bracket rows reproduced verbatim from hardcoded_defaults.py's own Chennai PT_FLAT rows (sort_order 48-53); state_rate_map's pt_half_year_deduct_month_1 is fixture-local (the document gives no remittance month for Chennai's own collection cycle, so hardcoded_defaults.py deliberately doesn't seed one — this fixture supplies its own so the half-year gate can be exercised). Run through the real production engine (calculate_payroll) at authoring time.
